case.title: Latitude inside Kondele's band but longitude about 5.6 m east of its eastern edge

submissions.open_text: Communal tap closes at noon so children miss lessons.
Family collects from the stream behind the church.

case.why: Latitude -0.08 is well within -0.09..-0.07, but longitude 34.78005 exceeds the east edge 34.78 by 0.00005 deg (about 5.6 m at the equator), so the point is outside. An implementation that only checks latitude, only checks the west bound (lng >= 34.76), or uses an inclusive buffer would wrongly stay silent. Other checks quiet: 2 submissions over 4 h apart, distinct texts, durations above 12 min, daytime, one device, no transcripts.

review: Corrected in review: 5.6 m outside is inside GPS error (no accuracy reported, so the 15 m floor applies).
